summary.text: Thaddeus Laugisch is the Democratic candidate for Minnesota House of Representatives District 4B in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He has worked as a construction professional, an agricultural facility designer and a safety director for a general contractor, and he was also the Democratic candidate for the seat in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Thaddeus Laugisch was born at Offutt Air Force Base in Bellevue, Nebraska, and earned a high school diploma from Bellevue East High School.
He attended Metro Community College, Concordia University and the North Dakota State College of Science.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a designer and safety director of 16 years for a commercial agricultural general contractor, a father of two daughters, a community volunteer and an artist.
Laugisch ran for District 4B in 2024, when Jim Joy defeated him in the general election.
In his 2026 survey responses, he said a representative should listen to constituents and that rural communities, small businesses and the district's local traditions are priorities.
